name: Power Heat pump on (1011)
description: On/off state of the heat pump (1 = on), workbook register 1011. The climate entity turns it on and off.
guidance: On a Trianco S300, opening the remote on/off contacts set Power to 0 and closing them set it to 1 by the next read. Whether Home Assistant can override open contacts is not known, so avoid switching it from both.

name: Mode Requested mode (1012)
description: Mode requested of the controller, workbook register 1012. 0 Intelligent, 2 Eco, 3 Hybrid, 4 Fast heating, 7 Vacation.
guidance: Read-only here. The writable Select Mode entity writes mode_real (1013), which is what the app and this S300 showed changing. Local Modbus tests write 1012 as the requested mode.

name: Manual-mute
description: Fan mode code of other models, requested for compatibility. Empty on HiTemp.

name: Set_Temp
description: Setpoint code of other models, requested for compatibility. Empty on HiTemp.

name: mode_real Operating mode (1013)
app_range: Intelligent Mode, Eco Mode, Hybrid Mode, Fast Heating Mode
description: Operating mode shown as the actual mode, workbook register 1013. Hybrid is the manual's Standard mode and Fast heating its High demand mode.
guidance: Eco heats with the heat pump only. Hybrid lets the electric heater help after R06 minutes. Fast heating runs the heater at once. Intelligent chooses from the ambient temperature. Vacation is Mode 7 and does not replace this value. Writes stay on this code.

name: MO6
description: Requested by the original integration. Empty on HiTemp, meaning unknown.

name: M17 Fan after heating (1016)
app_range: Ventilation ON/OFF, Air Speed Low or High
description: What the fan does once the water has reached its target: low, high, or off. Workbook register 1016. This is a setting, not the fan-running bits.
guidance: While heating, the controller runs the fan itself. The climate entity's fan modes write this same code. The Indol range goes to 5; this unit uses 0-2.

name: Version
description: Version code of other models. Empty on HiTemp, see code_version and MainBoard Version.

name: Software Code
description: Software code of other models. Empty on HiTemp, see code_version and MainBoard Version.

name: /01 OUT05 use (1020)
description: What output O05 is used for: fan low speed or a solar pump. Workbook register 1020.
guidance: The heat pump reports 1, which the app can't name either, so the active function isn't known. The cloud declares one more value than the app lists (0-2 for /01, 0-3 for /02), so the app's list may be incomplete. Read-only.

name: /02 OUT06 use (1021)
app_range: No output, Solar water pump, Solar water release valve
description: What output O06 is used for. Workbook register 1021. The value 1 is outside the names the app lists.
guidance: The heat pump reports 1, which the app can't name either, so the active function isn't known. The cloud declares one more value than the app lists (0-2 for /01, 0-3 for /02), so the app's list may be incomplete. Read-only.

name: D01 Defrost start temperature (1034)
description: Defrost start temperature. Workbook register 1034. Stays a disabled installer control.
guidance: Defrost starts when the coil (T04) is below D01 and at least D03 minutes have passed since the last one. It ends when T04 reaches D02 or after D04 minutes, and lasts at least D05 minutes (PHNIX manuals). During a defrost the compressor keeps running and the fan stops (Trianco S300 manual). A lower D01 means fewer, later defrosts. Change it only if the coil ices up or defrosts too often.

name: D02 Defrost end temperature (1035)
description: Defrost end temperature. Workbook register 1035. Stays a disabled installer control.
guidance: Defrost starts when the coil (T04) is below D01 and at least D03 minutes have passed since the last one. It ends when T04 reaches D02 or after D04 minutes, and lasts at least D05 minutes (PHNIX manuals). During a defrost the compressor keeps running and the fan stops (Trianco S300 manual). A higher D02 clears the ice more thoroughly but lasts longer.

name: D03 Defrost interval (1036)
description: Defrost interval. Workbook register 1036. Stays a disabled installer control.
guidance: Defrost starts when the coil (T04) is below D01 and at least D03 minutes have passed since the last one. It ends when T04 reaches D02 or after D04 minutes, and lasts at least D05 minutes (PHNIX manuals). During a defrost the compressor keeps running and the fan stops (Trianco S300 manual).

name: D04 Maximum defrost time (1037)
description: Maximum defrost time. Workbook register 1037. Stays a disabled installer control.
guidance: Defrost starts when the coil (T04) is below D01 and at least D03 minutes have passed since the last one. It ends when T04 reaches D02 or after D04 minutes, and lasts at least D05 minutes (PHNIX manuals). During a defrost the compressor keeps running and the fan stops (Trianco S300 manual).

name: D05 Minimum defrost time (1038)
description: Minimum defrost time. Workbook register 1038. Stays a disabled installer control.
guidance: Defrost starts when the coil (T04) is below D01 and at least D03 minutes have passed since the last one. It ends when T04 reaches D02 or after D04 minutes, and lasts at least D05 minutes (PHNIX manuals). During a defrost the compressor keeps running and the fan stops (Trianco S300 manual).

name: D06 Defrost method (1039)
description: Defrost method. Workbook register 1039. Stays a disabled installer control.
guidance: Standard uses D01-D05; Intelligent also uses D07. What Economic changes isn't documented. Your heat pump reports 0 = Standard; 1 and 2 follow the app's order.

name: D07 Intelligent defrost threshold (1040)
description: Intelligent defrost threshold. Workbook register 1040. Stays a disabled installer control.
guidance: Not documented; it probably compares the ambient and coil temperatures. It only matters with D06 = Intelligent. Leave it unchanged.

name: E01 EEV control mode (1055)
description: Manual or automatic electronic expansion valve. Workbook register 1055. Stays a disabled control.
guidance: Keep Automatic. In Manual the valve no longer follows the superheat target E02, which can return liquid refrigerant to the compressor or starve the coil.

name: E02 Target superheat (1056)
description: Superheat the valve aims for in automatic mode. Workbook register 1056. Stays a disabled control.
guidance: Compare it with the Superheat sensor. A higher target closes the valve further (less refrigerant, safer for the compressor, less heat); a lower one opens it. Change it only with an installer: too little superheat can return liquid to the compressor.

name: E03 EEV start position (1057)
description: Valve position when heating starts. Workbook register 1057. Stays a disabled control.
guidance: The valve starts at E03 (O07 reads 240 at start-up) and then regulates towards E02.

name: E04 EEV minimum position (1058)
description: Most closed position the valve is allowed. Workbook register 1058. Stays a disabled control.
guidance: Your EEV often sits at this minimum because the measured superheat is below E02. Lowering E04 lets it close further and reduces the refrigerant flow; don't change it to chase the superheat reading without an installer.

name: E05 EEV defrost position (1059)
description: Valve position used while defrosting. Workbook register 1059. On this S300 it moved to 480 during defrost.
guidance: O07 reads this value (480) during defrost and while the compressor is stopped.

name: G01 Disinfection temperature (1046)
description: Tank temperature the disinfection cycle heats to. Workbook register 1046. Stays a disabled control.
guidance: Disinfection (anti-legionella) heats the water to G01 every G04 days at G03 o'clock and holds it for G02 minutes. G02 = 0, as on your heat pump, most likely means it never runs. Above 60 °C (the limit of R01) the booster is probably needed.

name: G02 Disinfection duration (1047)
description: How long disinfection holds that temperature. Workbook register 1047. Stays a disabled control.
guidance: Disinfection (anti-legionella) heats the water to G01 every G04 days at G03 o'clock and holds it for G02 minutes. G02 = 0, as on your heat pump, most likely means it never runs. Above 60 °C (the limit of R01) the booster is probably needed.

name: G03 Disinfection start hour (1048)
description: Hour of the day disinfection may start. Workbook register 1048. Stays a disabled control.
guidance: Disinfection (anti-legionella) heats the water to G01 every G04 days at G03 o'clock and holds it for G02 minutes. G02 = 0, as on your heat pump, most likely means it never runs. Above 60 °C (the limit of R01) the booster is probably needed.

name: G04 Disinfection interval (1049)
description: Days between disinfection cycles. Workbook register 1049. Stays a disabled control.
guidance: Disinfection (anti-legionella) heats the water to G01 every G04 days at G03 o'clock and holds it for G02 minutes. G02 = 0, as on your heat pump, most likely means it never runs. Above 60 °C (the limit of R01) the booster is probably needed.

name: H01 Remember power state (1067)
app_name: Remember the power status of device when power down
description: Whether the controller stores the on/off state through a power cut. Workbook register 1067. On this S300, YES explains the T21 writes when Power changes.
guidance: YES restarts heating after a power cut if it was on before. Keep YES unless it should stay off. On a Trianco S300 every on/off, including from the remote contacts, raised T21 by 4, so with YES each switch is most likely written to the controller's memory.

name: H03 Heating source (1069)
description: Heating source selection. Workbook register 1069. The listed value is air source.

name: H07 Temperature unit (1073)
description: Celsius or Fahrenheit for the display. Workbook register 1073.
guidance: The Temperature Unit select in Home Assistant must match it. If you change H07 in the app, change the select as well.

name: H30 Panel address (1076)
description: Address parameter of the wired panel, workbook register 1076. It is not the Wi-Fi Modbus slave, which answers at 99.
guidance: Read-only: a wrong address can cut the controller off from the Wi-Fi module.

name: H31 Control mode (1077)
description: Whether control is centralised or by the DTU/Wi-Fi module. Workbook register 1077.
guidance: Must stay on DTU&WIFI for the app and Home Assistant to work, so it is read-only.

name: H32 Cloud upload interval (1066)
app_name: Circle of submitting data to Cloud
description: Minutes between the heat pump's own uploads to the cloud. Workbook register 1066. Stays a disabled control.
guidance: Your heat pump uses 1 minute. Home Assistant reads the cloud every 5 minutes, so a larger value only makes the readings older. Keep 1.

name: H98 Model selection (1074)
description: Selects the unit model. Workbook register 1074. Home Assistant does not write it.
guidance: Never change it: it tells the controller which hardware it drives. Your heat pump reports 2, which the app shows as 0X08. The cloud declares a range of 2-3, which supports 3 = 0X18, but that isn't confirmed.

name: H99 Display temperature compensation (1075)
description: Whether the shown temperature is compensated. Workbook register 1075. Stays a disabled control because the effect is not confirmed.
guidance: Not documented; it possibly corrects the displayed temperature. Keep NO.

name: N01 Solar pump control sensor (1080)
app_name: The sensor to control solar water pump
description: Solar pump control sensor. Workbook register 1080. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment. Recorded rather than hidden.
guidance: Solar circuit setting. Your installation has no solar circuit, so the N codes presumably have no effect; several hold values outside the app's own range (for example N07 = -25.0). Read-only.

name: N02 Solar pump maximum run time (1081)
app_name: Longest running time of solar water pump
description: Solar pump maximum run time. Workbook register 1081. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment. Recorded rather than hidden.
guidance: Solar circuit setting. Your installation has no solar circuit, so the N codes presumably have no effect; several hold values outside the app's own range (for example N07 = -25.0). Read-only.

name: N03 Solar pump hysteresis (1082)
app_name: Temp hysteresis of solar water pump
description: Solar pump hysteresis. Workbook register 1082. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment. Recorded rather than hidden.
guidance: Solar circuit setting. Your installation has no solar circuit, so the N codes presumably have no effect; several hold values outside the app's own range (for example N07 = -25.0). Read-only.

name: N04 Night temperature reduction (1083)
app_name: Activate the nighttime temp decreases mode
description: Night temperature reduction. Workbook register 1083. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment. Recorded rather than hidden.
guidance: It may lower the target between N05 and N06 o'clock; your heat pump has it set to YES for 02:00-03:00. Whether it applies without a solar circuit isn't known. Read-only.

name: N05 Night reduction start hour (1084)
app_name: Startup point of the nighttime temp decreases mode
description: Night reduction start hour. Workbook register 1084. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment. Recorded rather than hidden.
guidance: It may lower the target between N05 and N06 o'clock; your heat pump has it set to YES for 02:00-03:00. Whether it applies without a solar circuit isn't known. Read-only.

name: N06 Night reduction end hour (1085)
app_name: Shutdown point of the nighttime temp decreases mode
description: Night reduction end hour. Workbook register 1085. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment. Recorded rather than hidden.
guidance: It may lower the target between N05 and N06 o'clock; your heat pump has it set to YES for 02:00-03:00. Whether it applies without a solar circuit isn't known. Read-only.

name: N07 Solar water cooling start temperature (1086)
app_name: Startup temp of decreasing solar water temp
description: Solar water cooling start temperature. Workbook register 1086. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment.
guidance: Solar circuit setting. Your installation has no solar circuit, so the N codes presumably have no effect; several hold values outside the app's own range (for example N07 = -25.0). Read-only.

name: N08 Solar water cooling stop hysteresis (1087)
app_name: Temp hysteresis of stopping decreasing solar water temp
description: Solar water cooling stop hysteresis. Workbook register 1087. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment.
guidance: Solar circuit setting. Your installation has no solar circuit, so the N codes presumably have no effect; several hold values outside the app's own range (for example N07 = -25.0). Read-only.

name: N09 Solar water release temperature (1088)
description: Solar water release temperature. Workbook register 1088. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment.
guidance: Solar circuit setting. Your installation has no solar circuit, so the N codes presumably have no effect; several hold values outside the app's own range (for example N07 = -25.0). Read-only.

name: N10 Solar pump stop temperature (1089)
app_name: Shutdown temp of solar water pump
description: Solar pump stop temperature. Workbook register 1089. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment.
guidance: Solar circuit setting. Your installation has no solar circuit, so the N codes presumably have no effect; several hold values outside the app's own range (for example N07 = -25.0). Read-only.

name: N11 Solar pump working mode (1090)
app_name: Working mode of solar water pump
description: Solar pump working mode. Workbook register 1090. Solar-thermal control, not photovoltaic curtailment.
guidance: Solar circuit setting. Your installation has no solar circuit, so the N codes presumably have no effect; several hold values outside the app's own range (for example N07 = -25.0). Read-only.

name: R01 Target water temperature (1104)
description: Target water temperature, workbook register 1104. The climate entity writes it.
guidance: Heating starts when the controlling sensor (T02 bottom, or T03 top with R17 = YES) drops R03 below R01, and stops at R01. Each change is probably stored in the controller's memory, which allows a limited number of writes (see T12), so avoid automations that change R01 every few minutes.

name: R03 Start hysteresis bottom (1106)
app_name: Hysteresis of heat pump startup(bottom sensor)
description: How far the bottom sensor must fall below the target before heating starts. Workbook register 1106.
guidance: A small value keeps the water closer to R01 but starts the compressor more often; very small values cause short cycling. Your heat pump uses 5.0 °C.

name: R04 Use R05 as booster setpoint (1107)
app_name: Enable R05 as setpoint of booster?
description: Whether the booster uses R05 as its own target. Workbook register 1107.
guidance: Electric heater logic (Trianco S300 manual): in Standard mode the heater starts if the target isn't reached after R06 minutes; in High demand mode it starts without the delay; in Eco mode it never starts; both decide with the R03 differential. Intelligent mode picks Eco above R10 ambient (T01), Standard between R09 and R10 and High demand between R08 and R09; with R07 = YES the heater presumably replaces the heat pump below R08. The heater output is O02. Only relevant with an electric heater fitted.

name: R05 Booster setpoint (1108)
description: Separate target for the electric heater when R04 is YES. Workbook register 1108.
guidance: Electric heater logic (Trianco S300 manual): in Standard mode the heater starts if the target isn't reached after R06 minutes; in High demand mode it starts without the delay; in Eco mode it never starts; both decide with the R03 differential. Intelligent mode picks Eco above R10 ambient (T01), Standard between R09 and R10 and High demand between R08 and R09; with R07 = YES the heater presumably replaces the heat pump below R08. The heater output is O02. Only relevant with an electric heater fitted.

name: R06 Booster start delay (1109)
description: Minutes the heat pump runs before the heater may help, in Hybrid. Workbook register 1109. The cloud step is 5.
guidance: Electric heater logic (Trianco S300 manual): in Standard mode the heater starts if the target isn't reached after R06 minutes; in High demand mode it starts without the delay; in Eco mode it never starts; both decide with the R03 differential. Intelligent mode picks Eco above R10 ambient (T01), Standard between R09 and R10 and High demand between R08 and R09; with R07 = YES the heater presumably replaces the heat pump below R08. The heater output is O02. Only relevant with an electric heater fitted.

name: R07 Booster replaces heat pump (1110)
description: Whether the booster runs instead of the heat pump. Workbook register 1110. Stays a disabled installer control.
guidance: Electric heater logic (Trianco S300 manual): in Standard mode the heater starts if the target isn't reached after R06 minutes; in High demand mode it starts without the delay; in Eco mode it never starts; both decide with the R03 differential. Intelligent mode picks Eco above R10 ambient (T01), Standard between R09 and R10 and High demand between R08 and R09; with R07 = YES the heater presumably replaces the heat pump below R08. The heater output is O02. Only relevant with an electric heater fitted. With YES and no booster fitted, the heat pump presumably stops heating below R08 (-5.0 °C on your unit).

name: R08 Booster only below ambient (1111)
app_name: Setpoint of ambient temp to activate booster to replace heatpump
description: Ambient temperature below which Intelligent mode uses the booster only. Workbook register 1111.
guidance: Electric heater logic (Trianco S300 manual): in Standard mode the heater starts if the target isn't reached after R06 minutes; in High demand mode it starts without the delay; in Eco mode it never starts; both decide with the R03 differential. Intelligent mode picks Eco above R10 ambient (T01), Standard between R09 and R10 and High demand between R08 and R09; with R07 = YES the heater presumably replaces the heat pump below R08. The heater output is O02. Only relevant with an electric heater fitted.

name: R09 Booster without delay below ambient (1112)
app_name: Setpoint of ambient temp to activate booster without delay
description: Ambient temperature below which the booster starts with no delay. Workbook register 1112.
guidance: Electric heater logic (Trianco S300 manual): in Standard mode the heater starts if the target isn't reached after R06 minutes; in High demand mode it starts without the delay; in Eco mode it never starts; both decide with the R03 differential. Intelligent mode picks Eco above R10 ambient (T01), Standard between R09 and R10 and High demand between R08 and R09; with R07 = YES the heater presumably replaces the heat pump below R08. The heater output is O02. Only relevant with an electric heater fitted.

name: R10 Booster with delay below ambient (1113)
app_name: Setpoint of ambient temp to activate booster with delay
description: Ambient temperature below which the booster starts after the R06 delay. Workbook register 1113.
guidance: Electric heater logic (Trianco S300 manual): in Standard mode the heater starts if the target isn't reached after R06 minutes; in High demand mode it starts without the delay; in Eco mode it never starts; both decide with the R03 differential. Intelligent mode picks Eco above R10 ambient (T01), Standard between R09 and R10 and High demand between R08 and R09; with R07 = YES the heater presumably replaces the heat pump below R08. The heater output is O02. Only relevant with an electric heater fitted.

name: R12 Compressor cutoff ambient (1115)
app_name: Ambient temp of shutting down compressor compulsively
description: Ambient temperature that forces the compressor off. Workbook register 1115.

name: R14 Second heat source target (1117)
app_name: The target temp of second heating source
description: Target temperature of the second heating source named by S06. Workbook register 1117.
guidance: Your heat pump holds -10.0, outside the app's own range, which suggests it isn't used.

name: R15 Maximum compressor ambient (1118)
app_name: Maximal ambient temp of working compressor
description: Highest ambient temperature at which the compressor may run. Workbook register 1118.
guidance: A 55-80 °C range fits a water or refrigerant limit better than an air temperature.

name: R17 Top sensor controls compressor (1120)
app_name: Enable top sensor to control compressor?
description: Whether the top tank sensor, rather than the bottom sensor, decides when the compressor runs. Workbook register 1120.

name: R18 Start hysteresis top (1121)
app_name: Hysteresis of heat pump startup(top sensor)
description: How far the top sensor must fall below the target before heating starts. Workbook register 1121.

name: R19 Compressor stop setpoint 1 (1122)
app_name: Setpoint 1 of ambient temp to stop compressor
description: First ambient setpoint that stops the compressor. Workbook register 1122.
guidance: Not documented. A 30-90 °C range fits a water temperature better than an air temperature.

name: R20 Compressor stop setpoint 2 (1123)
app_name: Setpoint 2 of ambient temp to stop compressor
description: Second ambient setpoint that stops the compressor. Workbook register 1123.
guidance: Not documented. A 30-90 °C range fits a water temperature better than an air temperature.

name: O01 Compressor running (2050.8)
description: Bit 8 of register 2050. 1 means the compressor is running.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code stays empty and is probed separately.

name: O02 Heater running (2050.9)
description: Bit 9 of register 2050. 1 means the electric heater is running.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code stays empty and is probed separately.

name: O03 Reversing valve on (2050.10)
description: Bit 10 of register 2050. 1 means the reversing valve is energised. This is not register 2055.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code stays empty and is probed separately.

name: O04 Fan running high (2050.11)
description: Bit 11 of register 2050. 1 means the high-speed fan output is on. Which speed this unit uses is not confirmed.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code stays empty and is probed separately.

name: O05 Fan running low (2050.12)
description: Bit 12 of register 2050. 1 means the low-speed fan or solar-pump output is on.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code stays empty and is probed separately.

name: O06 Spare output on (2050.13)
description: Bit 13 of register 2050. 1 means the spare or solar output is on.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code stays empty and is probed separately.

name: O07 EEV position (2060)
description: Current electronic expansion valve position in steps. Workbook register 2060.
guidance: On your heat pump it reads 480 (E05) while stopped or defrosting, starts at E03 (240) when heating begins, then works down towards E04 (100) as it regulates the superheat. Plot it with the Superheat sensor and E02.

name: O08 Compressor hours (2061)
description: Accumulated compressor running hours. Workbook register 2061.
guidance: A statistics graph with the 'change' statistic per day shows the daily running hours.

name: O09 Heater hours (2062)
description: Accumulated electric heater running hours. Workbook register 2062. Victor's O18 alias for this address conflicts with the workbook and is not used.
guidance: A statistics graph with the 'change' statistic per day shows the daily running hours.

name: O10 Anode 3V on (2050.14)
description: Bit 14 of register 2050. 1 means the 3 V anode output is on. The workbook calls this bit O12.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The app's O number is kept; the workbook uses a higher O number for the same bit.

name: O11 Anode MV on (2050.15)
description: Bit 15 of register 2050. 1 means the MV anode output is on. The workbook calls this bit O13.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The app's O number is kept; the workbook uses a higher O number for the same bit.

name: O12 Heating stopped (2051.0)
description: Bit 0 of register 2051. 1 means the thermostat is satisfied and heating has stopped. The workbook calls this bit O14.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The app's O number is kept; the workbook uses a higher O number for the same bit.

name: O13 Wi-Fi link up (2051.1)
description: Bit 1 of register 2051. 1 means the DTU/Wi-Fi link is up. The workbook calls this bit O15.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The app's O number is kept; the workbook uses a higher O number for the same bit.

name: O14 Defrost running (2051.2)
description: Bit 2 of register 2051. 1 means a defrost is running. The workbook calls this bit O16.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The app's O number is kept; the workbook uses a higher O number for the same bit.

name: O15 Hot water stage active (2051.3)
description: Bit 3 of register 2051. 1 means the hot-water stage is active. The workbook calls this bit O17.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The app's O number is kept; the workbook uses a higher O number for the same bit.

name: S01 Remote switch open (2050.0)
description: Bit 0 of register 2050. 1 means the remote on/off switch is open. On this S300 that matches Power off.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code itself stays empty; it is still probed so a future value would show up in diagnostics.

name: S02 Overheat switch closed (2050.1)
description: Bit 1 of register 2050. The dtu_wifi sheet leaves this bit blank. The other sheet calls it overheat protection and uses 1 for closed. Polarity is uncertain.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code itself stays empty; it is still probed so a future value would show up in diagnostics.

name: S03 Low pressure switch open (2050.2)
description: Bit 2 of register 2050. 1 means the low pressure switch is open. An earlier coil-temperature guess is not the workbook meaning.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code itself stays empty; it is still probed so a future value would show up in diagnostics.

name: S04 High pressure switch open (2050.3)
description: Bit 3 of register 2050. 1 means the high pressure switch is open. EvoHeat labels this input DI04.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code itself stays empty; it is still probed so a future value would show up in diagnostics.

name: S05 Heater boost switch open (2050.4)
app_name: Accelerate the running time of heater
description: Bit 4 of register 2050. 1 means the heater time-shorten input is open.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code itself stays empty; it is still probed so a future value would show up in diagnostics.

name: S06 External heat switch active (2050.5)
description: Bit 5 of register 2050, the external heat-source input. The workbook does not state the polarity. On this S300 the bit is often set.
guidance: Read from the packed status word. The named cloud code itself stays empty; it is still probed so a future value would show up in diagnostics.

name: T01 Ambient temperature (2019)
description: Air temperature at the heat pump's air inlet. Workbook register 2019 (T01), the ambient sensor on AI01.
guidance: The booster settings R08-R10 and the compressor limit R12 compare against it. Seen on a Trianco S300 and named Ambient in the HiTemp app.

name: T02 Bottom water temperature (2020)
description: Water temperature at the controller's bottom sensor (workbook T02, register 2020). The controller is made for a tank with bottom and top sensors; on this installation it is on the return pipe.
guidance: With R17 = NO this sensor controls heating: it starts when T02 is R03 below R01.

name: T03 Top water temperature (2021)
description: Water temperature at the controller's top sensor (workbook T03, register 2021); on this installation the flow pipe.
guidance: T03 - T02 is the Water ΔT sensor. T10 showed the same value as T03 throughout your log.

name: T04 Coil temperature (2022)
description: Temperature of the evaporator coil (workbook T04, register 2022), the coil the air passes through.
guidance: Defrost starts and ends on this temperature (D01, D02). It is also the reference for the superheat (T05 - T04).

name: T05 Suction temperature (2023)
description: Refrigerant temperature in the suction pipe (workbook T05, register 2023), the gas going from the coil to the compressor. It is not an air temperature.
guidance: With E01 = Automatic the EEV keeps T05 - T04 (superheat) at E02. When T05 stays well below T04, as in your log (about -13 °C against 0 °C), the superheat is negative and the EEV closes to its minimum E04. The data can't tell whether that comes from the sensor placement or the refrigerant circuit; ask an installer rather than changing E02 or E04.

name: T10 Displayed water temperature (2025)
description: Water temperature shown on the display and in the app (workbook T10, register 2025); the climate entity's current temperature.
guidance: Equal to T03 throughout your log.

name: T06 Discharge temperature (2024)
description: Workbook register 2024 (T06) is the solar collector temperature. This entity keeps the discharge name because that is how the value behaves on a Trianco S300.
guidance: On a Trianco S300 it rises to 60-90 °C while the compressor runs and drops when it stops, while a missing sensor reads about -30 °C. That fits compressor discharge (hot gas), not a solar collector. Treat the workbook name and the S300 behaviour as a conflict.

name: T11 Out-of-range count empty
description: Named count that the cloud leaves empty on this product. The workbook count is T20 at register 2026.
guidance: Use T20 for the out-of-range count. This entity stays so an empty cloud code is visible.

name: T12 EEPROM write count empty
description: Named count that the cloud leaves empty on this product. The workbook EEPROM write count is T21 at register 2027.
guidance: Use T21 for the settings-write count.

name: State0 Operating status (2050)
description: Packed operating status. Bit 0 is the right-most digit. Outputs and switches O01-O06 and S01-S06 live in this word.
guidance: Decoded on a Trianco S300: bit 0 while the unit is switched off, bit 5 always, bit 8 while the compressor runs, bit 9 while the electric heater is on, bit 10 only during defrost (probably the 4-way valve), bits 11 and 12 while the fan runs (both clear during defrost, when the manual says the fan stops). Bit 2 cleared when the coil (T04) fell to about -3 °C (D01) and set again after a defrost or a stop; its meaning isn't confirmed. On an Indol PV300 with the same product ID (github.com/victor987/hitemp), bits 8 and 9 behaved the same.

name: O01 Compressor running (2050.8)
description: Bit 8 of register 2050. 1 means the compressor is running.
guidance: Confirmed on a Trianco S300 against the app; it also followed the compressor on an Indol PV300 with the same product ID.

name: O02 Heater running (2050.9)
description: Bit 9 of register 2050. 1 means the electric heater is running.
guidance: Confirmed on a Trianco S300: it came on with the app's electric heater (O02) and Electric heating switch in Fast heating mode.

name: O14 Defrost running (2051.2)
description: Bit 2 of register 2051. 1 means a defrost is running. The workbook calls this bit O16; the app code is O14.
guidance: On a Trianco S300 it was set for about 3 minutes every 45-49 minutes while the EEV moved to its defrost position (E05), the suction temperature jumped to 25-35 °C, the coil warmed up and the fan stopped, as the manual describes for defrost. Defrosts started with the coil (T04) at about D01 and at least D03 minutes after the previous one.

name: M06 Booster mode (1014)
description: Workbook register 1014, booster works independently (1 on, 2 off, 0 instruction complete). It is not the electric-heater-running bit.
guidance: On a Trianco S300 this stays 0 while the heater bit of 2050 is set. Do not use it as the heater state. It is recorded, not offered as a control.

name: O29 Fan speed
description: Fan speed code. Victor matched it to 2067, which the workbook leaves blank, so the address is not shown. It read 0 on this S300 while heating.
guidance: On an Indol PV300 with the same product ID (github.com/victor987/hitemp), it read 0 with the fan off and about 570 to 830 rpm when running. On a Trianco S300 it read 0 while the compressor ran, so it is disabled by default.

name: T07 Discharge temperature unconfirmed
description: A temperature code with no address in the EVO270 dtu_wifi sheet. It reads about -30 °C on a Trianco S300, the value of a missing sensor.
guidance: Do not treat this as discharge. T06 is the value that rises while the compressor runs. Victor's equal-value alias 2028 is blank in the workbook, so it is not used.

name: T09 Compressor temperature unconfirmed
description: A temperature code with no confirmed address. Victor matched it to 2030, which is the status word on the other Modbus sheet, not a temperature on dtu_wifi.
guidance: Leave it as an unknown reading. It is enabled so the value is recorded.

name: L01 Vacation enabled (1129.0)
description: Bit 0 of register 1129 (L01). 1 means the vacation date is enabled. This is a schedule arm, not a sign that the heat pump is running.
guidance: Turning vacation mode on in the app set this bit, changed Mode to 7 and stored the date in L02-L04; turning it off cleared the bit. Read-only.

name: L02-L04 Vacation date (1130-1132)
description: Vacation return date built from L02 year, L03 month and L04 day, registers 1130-1132.
guidance: The app showed 28-05-2010 while L02-L04 read 10, 5 and 28. Read-only.

name: L06-L07 Timer 1 start (1134-1135)
description: Clock time when timer 1 turns the heat pump on, from L06 and L07.
guidance: Setting timer 1 to 9:00-13:00 and timer 2 to 17:00-19:00 in the app set the hours in L06, L08, L10 and L12; L07 holds the minutes. Whether the timer is switched on is in 1133. Read-only.

name: L08-L09 Timer 1 stop (1136-1137)
description: Clock time when timer 1 turns the heat pump off, from L08 and L09.
guidance: Setting timer 1 to 9:00-13:00 and timer 2 to 17:00-19:00 in the app set the hours in L06, L08, L10 and L12; L09 holds the minutes. Whether the timer is switched on is in 1133. Read-only.

name: L10-L11 Timer 2 start (1138-1139)
description: Clock time when timer 2 turns the heat pump on, from L10 and L11.
guidance: Setting timer 1 to 9:00-13:00 and timer 2 to 17:00-19:00 in the app set the hours in L06, L08, L10 and L12; L11 holds the minutes. Whether the timer is switched on is in 1133. Read-only.

name: L12-L13 Timer 2 stop (1140-1141)
description: Clock time when timer 2 turns the heat pump off, from L12 and L13.
guidance: Setting timer 1 to 9:00-13:00 and timer 2 to 17:00-19:00 in the app set the hours in L06, L08, L10 and L12; L13 holds the minutes. Whether the timer is switched on is in 1133. Read-only.

name: L05 Timer enables (1133)
description: Packed timer enables. Bits 0-3 arm timer 1 start, timer 1 stop, timer 2 start and timer 2 stop. They do not mean the heat pump is running.
guidance: Switching on all four timer switches in the app set bits 0-3, switching them off cleared them. Which bit is which switch isn't known yet.

name: L01 Vacation flags (1129)
description: Packed vacation flags. Bit 0 is the vacation date enable.

name: T21 Settings write count (2027)
description: Workbook register 2027 (T21), the number of times the controller has written its settings memory.
guidance: On a Trianco S300 this rose by 4 each time the remote on/off contacts changed Power, because H01 remembers that state.

name: T20 Out-of-range count (2026)
description: Workbook register 2026 (T20), how many times a parameter was written outside its allowed range.
guidance: The named code T11 is empty on this product. This register is the one the workbook defines.

name: L02 Vacation year (1130)
description: Vacation year, two digits (20YY). Workbook register 1130.

name: L03 Vacation month (1131)
description: Vacation month, 1-12. Workbook register 1131.

name: L04 Vacation day (1132)
description: Vacation day, 1-31. Workbook register 1132.

name: L06 Timer 1 start hour (1134)
description: Hour timer 1 switches on. Workbook register 1134.

name: L07 Timer 1 start minute (1135)
description: Minute timer 1 switches on. Workbook register 1135.

name: L08 Timer 1 stop hour (1136)
description: Hour timer 1 switches off. Workbook register 1136.

name: L09 Timer 1 stop minute (1137)
description: Minute timer 1 switches off. Workbook register 1137.

name: L10 Timer 2 start hour (1138)
description: Hour timer 2 switches on. Workbook register 1138.

name: L11 Timer 2 start minute (1139)
description: Minute timer 2 switches on. Workbook register 1139.

name: L12 Timer 2 stop hour (1140)
description: Hour timer 2 switches off. Workbook register 1140.

name: L13 Timer 2 stop minute (1141)
description: Minute timer 2 switches off. Workbook register 1141.

name: State1 Function status (2051)
description: Packed function status. Bit 2 is defrost. Bit 1 has stayed set while the Wi-Fi module is online.

name: Reg 1142 Flags
description: A flag word with no published bit legend.
guidance: All bits have been clear in the logs so far. The individual bits are recorded separately.

name: M11 Clock apply (1151)
description: Clock modify/apply flag, workbook register 1151.
guidance: Registers 1152-1156 are a command mailbox, not a continuously readable clock.

name: Fault0 Fault bits (2085)
description: Packed fault word. Named bits are sensor and protection faults.
guidance: A zero word means none of the listed faults are active. Display codes that are not in this word are not bits of it.

name: T08 Flags
description: A bitmask whose bits are not named in the workbook.
guidance: Victor's address 2029 is blank in the sheet and is not used.

name: F03 Flags
description: A configuration bitmask with no published bit legend.
guidance: Recorded so a set bit can be matched to a change on the heat pump.

name: L28 Flags
description: A schedule bitmask with no published bit legend and no workbook address.
guidance: Recorded so a set bit can be matched to a timer or schedule change.

name: T05-T04 Superheat (2023-2022)
description: Suction temperature minus coil temperature, T05 (2023) minus T04 (2022).
guidance: The value E02 targets. Negative values mean the suction pipe reads colder than the coil, which keeps the EEV at E04.

name: T03-T02 Water temperature rise (2021-2020)
description: Top water temperature minus bottom water temperature, T03 (2021) minus T02 (2020).
guidance: On your installation, how much the water warms up through the heat pump. Heat pumps are usually designed for about 5 °C; a much larger value can mean low water flow.
